bio.text: Christina Henderson is an At-Large member of the Council of the District of Columbia, serving since January 2021; the Council lists her as an Independent.
Before the Council she worked as a legislative assistant to U.S. Senator Charles Schumer, and from 2012 to 2017 in DC government, including as deputy chief of staff to Councilmember David Grosso.
She earned a BA in Political Science from Furman University and a Master in Public Affairs from Princeton University, and lives in Petworth.
